title: Plan Lock-In
body: Your plan may include a 3-month minimum commitment period. Early cancellation may result in applicable charges.

title: Star Number Lock-In
body: Star Numbers may have a 1- or 2-year commitment period, depending on the number selected.

title: Early Exit Charges
body: Cancelling, downgrading, transferring, porting out, or changing your service before the lock-in period ends may result in applicable penalties.

title: Lock-In Calculation
body: Any PYN or service barring period is not counted towards the lock-in period.

title: Number Reuse
body: If your service is cancelled, the mobile number may be reassigned after 180 days.
